title: Fine for crafts, not the nicest as is.
text: Fine for crafts, not the nicest as is.. I bought this for a craft project to repaint and decorate.  It looks nice from a distance but is very lightweight and not the most well fashioned piece.  It is not solid carved wood, more of a particle board material.  I'm making it into some much better but as is, it's pretty cheap in quality and something more suitable for a patio or bar.

product_metadata.title: Fetco Home Decor Anchor Wall Decor Fashion Themed Art
description: Fetco Home Decor's Coastal Themed product will bring a bit of the seashore to your home. Whether it is a interpretation of some of the natural elements of the sea or a fun beachy sentiment on rustic, driftwood inspired profiles our coastal decor will have you reminiscing of the shores.
